faits.fait: Santéclair is first and foremost a care network. It also manages third-party payment (tiers payant: the patient pays nothing upfront, insurers pay the provider directly) on behalf of supplementary health insurers.

Santéclair offers health professionals three agreements: Partenariat & tiers-payant (Partnership and third-party payment), Tiers-payant TP+ (TP+ third-party payment) and Partenariat simple (Simple partnership).
TP+ is Santéclair’s third-party payment service for professionals outside the network. Launched in 2018, it had recorded nearly 20 million coverage requests by April 2023, across all areas of care.
For third-party payment, Santéclair acts as a processor for the supplementary health insurers, which remain responsible for the data.
The optical network is formed through a call for tenders. The current network covers 2025 to 2029.
As of October 7, 2026, the optical network page states that no call for tenders is open.
During the 2024 call for tenders, creating the “Management d'activités” (Activity management) area required the SIREN number and an ID (national ID card or passport).

The dashboard in the “Gestion TP” (Third-party payment management) area tracks coverage requests, approvals, refusals, reimbursement requests and, in optical, exception requests. It is also used to upload additional documents.
The TP+ agreement includes the flow front end (FFL), which handles reimbursement requests from the store’s software.
EDI in the OptoAMC format is reserved for the Partenariat & tiers-payant agreement, not for TP+.
Santéclair reports a full automation rate of 95.2% for optical coverage requests in 2022.

In optical, coverage requests are submitted in a separate portal, “Mon portail FFL TP+ Optique” (My FFL TP+ Optical portal), opened from the services.santeclair.fr area. This portal is operated by FFL-Promoteur. Hearing care professionals use a different portal.
Each store logs in with its username and password, then enters a 6-digit code received by email. A checkbox lets you remember the browser for future logins.
To create a file, the optician chooses the insurer from a list, then enters the policy number, last name, first name and date of birth of the beneficiary.

conventionnement: On santeclair.fr, open the page for the chosen agreement (“Tiers-payant TP+” or “Partenariat & tiers-payant”) and select the “Optique” (Optical) area.
Create your “Management d'activités” area on services.santeclair.fr.
When creating the area, select your field and your agreement.
To join the partner network, apply from this area during a call for tenders. None is open as of October 7, 2026.
Once under agreement, log in to the partner area on services.santeclair.fr to manage third-party payment.

statuts.libelle: “En attente de traitement / En instance / En cours” (Awaiting processing / Pending / In progress)
statuts.sens: The file is still under review. The portal may announce processing within a few hours
statuts.action: Wait, then come back to check the file

statuts.sens: No coverage as submitted. The portal gives the reason and offers to print the refusal letter
statuts.action: Read the reason, correct, submit the request again

statuts.libelle: “N° Sécurité sociale inconnu” (Unknown social security number)
statuts.sens: The file is sent, but no coverage is found behind it
statuts.action: Check the social security number and the third-party payment card before delivering

statuts.sens: The TP+ portal is not responding, the request has not gone out
The invoice has gone out. The file search shows the bank transfer order
